name: rinx
description: Live preview and diagnostics for Rinx documentation

rinx.binaryPath.description: Path to the rinx binary, used by the preview and the language server. Can be a bare command (if in PATH) or an absolute path (e.g., /usr/local/bin/rinx). When unset, the binary is discovered through Bazel, falling back to `rinx` on the PATH.

rinx.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the rinx language server in the Rinx output channel.

rinx.autoDiscover.description: Automatically discover configuration from Bazel. Requires `bazel` to be on the PATH.

rinx.configPath.description: Fallback path to the rinx.toml config file (used when autoDiscover is disabled or fails)

rinx.templatePath.description: Fallback path to the HTML template used for rendering (used when autoDiscover is disabled or fails)

rinx.indexPath.description: Fallback path to the global project index (used when autoDiscover is disabled or fails)
